name: Uptime Per Monitor
query:
SELECT
    availability_monitor AS "Monitor:Link/Availability Monitor:200",
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN result = 'Online' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS "Uptime Percent:Percent:120",
    COUNT(*) AS "Total Checks:Int:120"
FROM
    `tabAvailability Monitor Log`
GROUP BY
    availability_monitor
ORDER BY
    2 DESC
